source: docs/2026 LCY EHS Dash Board.xlsx (SHA-256 0B94C09BEDF3C343D3250496780A2D3B66671B55741ABA0391FDE81BE8B51C10), sheets 'Rates' (rows 17-28 = 2025), 'Incident Data' and 'TRIR EXP.'
notes: Load with: python -m app.safety.legacy_import check|plan|apply <this file>. Not applied by any migration. These are 2025 rate numerators only; 2026 onward comes from Incident & Near Miss.

Completeness rule: null = blank in the source and unconfirmed; a number is a typed source value or a zero proven by an independent typed source total. Closing a 2025 month does not turn null into zero: a rate window containing a null for its measure is unavailable (count_not_confirmed).
Recordable: Rates!F17:F27 are blank and F28 (December) is a typed 0. TRIR EXP.!L8 types 0 recordables for 2025; counts cannot be negative, so every 2025 month is 0, stored as explicit zeros.
First Aid: Rates!G17:G28. Blank January, February, May, September and November stay null: no independent 2025 total confirms them.
LOPC: Incident Data row 58 (Spill/Release history, 2025), which types 0 for February and November where Rates!H18 and H27 are blank. Other months equal Rates!H17:H28.

Property & Equipment Damage: Rates!J17:J28 (Property damage), the workbook's combined damage row; it equals Incident Data row 122 except December (Rates!J28 is a typed 0, row 122 is blank). Blank February and October stay null: row 122 is blank in the same months and its Total is the sum of the same cells.

EXCLUDED (conflict): Rates!I28 (Number of Equipment Failure, December 2025) = 1 is not imported. It is not in Rates!J28 or Incident Data row 122, and the workbook does not say whether it is a separate event.

categories.name: Recordable <- Rates!F17:F28; blanks proven 0 by TRIR EXP.!L8
